author: SebDominguez
title: Useless ADF – Can’t even scan a long receipt!
content:
If you're buying this printer to scan receipts, invoices, or long documents using the top feeder (ADF), save your money and look elsewhere. Both the hardware and the HP Smart app are completely useless for basic document management.
The document feeder hard-caps paper length at 29 cm (standard A4 size). The moment a store receipt is slightly longer, the printer simply cuts the image off mid-scan or throws a paper size error. There is no "long paper mode," no option in the app to adjust custom page dimensions, and zero flexibility in the drivers. It’s absurd that a modern scanner can’t handle a standard paper-roll receipt without forcing you to cut it up, tape it to an A4 sheet, or take a picture with your phone—which completely defeats the point of having an automatic document feeder.
Between the rigid, clunky HP app and this ridiculous hardware limitation, this printer is a total waste of money for any serious expense tracking or office work. Avoid it.

HP OfficeJetPro 8025e, fresh from box refused to print direct from iPhone and insisted on printing via WiFi router over the network. This meant I couldn't print from the third of my house with a weak WiFi but what the heck. After March 2026 firmware update, the printer refused to print over network so I downloaded this app. It resized MS Word document from 2 to 3 pages and wants to give me arcade games, and other stuff when I just do t want to waste more than 15 seconds of my time printing a document that looks like I expect it to. Wish I'd kept my LaserJetIII. That printer was a bulletproof tank when you knew how to write print drivers. Update 2026, still two star; HP App not ready for prime time.
